slides.label: Verse 1
lines: We still perform great and mighty wonders,
When we call Your name Lord Jesus
And You still save, to the uttermost
Your name has never failed, it will never

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: Unchanging God, You are
Forever gracious, so kind and true
There’s no shadow of turning with You
The great I AM, at work in us

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: Unchanging God, You are
Forever good, so merciful
There’s no shadow of turning with You
The great I AM, at work in us

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: Your potent Word
That created the universe
Is the same we speak to be
All things respond to the sound of Your voice
Your Word has never failed, it will never
